title: SMAS lift (HIFU)
what: A machine sends focused ultrasound into the deep layers of the skin. With no cuts or injections, the skin gradually tightens.
why: For mild sagging of the face and neck skin, when a person does not want surgery.
duration: the procedure usually takes 30 to 90 minutes, and the effect builds over several months
tell_doctor: If you have implants, threads or metal plates in your face
If you have recently had cosmetic injections
Skin diseases and inflammation on your face

prepare.title: Skin
prepare.text: Come without makeup, or it will be removed at the clinic.

prepare.title: Sun
prepare.text: It is better to avoid tanning for a few days before.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop them on your own. Tell the doctor what you take.

bring: A list of your medicines, if you have any
steps: Your skin is cleaned and sometimes a numbing cream is applied
Gel is applied and the device head is placed on your skin
The device moves over your skin in lines - you feel the pulses
The gel is removed and a soothing cream is applied
feel: The pulses feel like warmth, tingling or short pricks, and in places are unpleasant
It can hurt more over bones
Afterwards there is mild redness and swelling, usually for a few days
after: You can usually go back to your day right away
No bath house or sauna for a few days
The result is judged after a few months
red_flags: Severe pain or numbness in the face that does not go away
Blisters or a burn on the skin
An uneven face or trouble moving your lips - see a doctor right away

faq.a: It can be unpleasant. Everyone's tolerance is different - tell the doctor, and the power can be adjusted.

faq.q: When will I see the result?
faq.a: Part of the effect shows right away, the main effect after a few months.

reminders.text: SMAS lift tomorrow. Come without makeup. If you have questions about medicines, ask your doctor.
